propositions: Author a project-owned code-review criterion that enforces phase-boundary contracts: Pass 1 discovers grounded findings only without assessment, Pass 2 verifies atomically without discovery or outcome, Pass 3 routes deterministically without LLM judgment, and Pass 4 coaches non-prescriptively without re-adjudication.
Criterion Pass-1 finder must emit grounded evidence only, omit severity/confidence/suggested_fix, and abstain when phase ownership is unclear.
Create a balanced twelve-case evaluation corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire, RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) that tests boundary violations in each phase and legitimate scope refinements.
Configure routing with exec=1-TURN, block_threshold=0.90, blocking_enabled=false, and single-turn execution to keep pilot runtime proportional to one Pass-1 call.
Achieve across three live runs: recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, kappa≥0.70, and minimum per-case stability≥2/3.
Implementation changes only project-owned .rebar assets, their .gitignore exceptions, criterion-specific tests, and the review-phase-boundaries subsection of docs/llm-framework.md.
